Back</a><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Bugbot usage-based billing</h1>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On May 11th, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/blog/may-2026-bugbot-changes">we announced</a> that Bugbot is moving from per-seat billing to usage-based billing for Teams and Individual plans. The average Bugbot run costs between $1.00 and $1.50, depending on PR size and complexity.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="when-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-take-effect"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#when-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-take-effect" data-heading-base-id="when-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-take-effect" aria-label="Copy link to when-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-take-effect"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">When does Bugbot usage-based billing take effect?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For new customers, Bugbot usage-based billing is available immediately.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For existing customers, the change applies at your <strong>next billing renewal after June 8th, 2026</strong>. Your current Bugbot billing stays the same until then.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Examples of when the change applies:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">If your monthly billing cycle starts on May 1st, 2026, the new billing model does not apply on June 1st. It applies to the cycle that starts on July 1st.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">If you purchased an annual subscription in May 2026, usage-based billing applies at your renewal in May 2027.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-teams"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-teams" data-heading-base-id="how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-teams" aria-label="Copy link to how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-teams"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How does Bugbot usage-based billing work for Teams?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Teams, Bugbot reviews are charged from on-demand usage. You can turn on on-demand usage from your <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/spending#on-demand-usage">Cursor dashboard</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-individual-plans"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-individual-plans" data-heading-base-id="how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-individual-plans" aria-label="Copy link to how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-individual-plans"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How does Bugbot usage-based billing work for Individual plans?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Individual plans, Bugbot bills first from included usage. Once your included usage is consumed, Bugbot bills from on-demand usage if you&#x27;ve enabled it.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If on-demand usage is disabled, Bugbot pauses until your next billing cycle, when limits reset. You can turn on on-demand usage from your <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/spending#on-demand-usage">Cursor dashboard</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="what-are-bugbot-effort-levels"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#what-are-bugbot-effort-levels" data-heading-base-id="what-are-bugbot-effort-levels" aria-label="Copy link to what-are-bugbot-effort-levels"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">What are Bugbot effort levels?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Alongside usage-based billing, Bugbot supports configurable effort levels for reviews:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Low:</strong> Optimizes for cost, with quality close to Default. Reviews are cheaper and take longer.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Default:</strong> Bugbot continues to use the same effort level as it does today. Optimized for efficiency and speed.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>High:</strong> Bugbot spends more time reasoning. Reviews are more expensive and take longer, but Bugbot may find more bugs.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Smart:</strong> Describe in natural language when Bugbot should use low, default, or high effort. Cursor will dynamically set effort levels based on your instructions.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">You can configure effort levels from <strong>Settings</strong> in <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/automations/from-cursor/bugbot">Bugbot Automations</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-to-switch-to-usage-based-bugbot-early"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-to-switch-to-usage-based-bugbot-early" data-heading-base-id="how-to-switch-to-usage-based-bugbot-early" aria-label="Copy link to how-to-switch-to-usage-based-bugbot-early"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How to switch to usage-based Bugbot early</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Existing customers can switch to usage-based Bugbot in their <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot?modal=migrate-bugbot">Cursor dashboard</a>.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If you switch early, Cursor will apply pro-rated credits for any pre-paid seat fees to your account.</p>

Back</a><div class="prose prose-lg max-w-none"><h1 class="text-large mb-8">Bugbot usage-based billing</h1>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">On May 11th, <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/blog/may-2026-bugbot-changes">we announced</a> that Bugbot is moving from per-seat billing to usage-based billing for Teams and Individual plans. The average Bugbot run costs between $1.00 and $1.50, depending on PR size and complexity.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="when-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-take-effect"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#when-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-take-effect" data-heading-base-id="when-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-take-effect" aria-label="Copy link to when-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-take-effect"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">When does Bugbot usage-based billing take effect?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For new customers, Bugbot usage-based billing is available immediately.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For existing customers, the change applies at your <strong>next billing renewal after June 8th, 2026</strong>. Your current Bugbot billing stays the same until then.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Examples of when the change applies:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">If your monthly billing cycle starts on May 1st, 2026, the new billing model does not apply on June 1st. It applies to the cycle that starts on July 1st.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">If you purchased an annual subscription in May 2026, usage-based billing applies at your renewal in May 2027.</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-teams"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-teams" data-heading-base-id="how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-teams" aria-label="Copy link to how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-teams"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How does Bugbot usage-based billing work for Teams?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Teams, Bugbot reviews are charged from on-demand usage. You can turn on on-demand usage from your <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/spending#on-demand-usage">Cursor dashboard</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-individual-plans"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-individual-plans" data-heading-base-id="how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-individual-plans" aria-label="Copy link to how-does-bugbot-usage-based-billing-work-for-individual-plans"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How does Bugbot usage-based billing work for Individual plans?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">For Individual plans, Bugbot bills first from included usage. Once your included usage is consumed, Bugbot bills from on-demand usage if you&#x27;ve enabled it.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If on-demand usage is disabled, Bugbot pauses until your next billing cycle, when limits reset. You can turn on on-demand usage from your <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/spending#on-demand-usage">Cursor dashboard</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="what-are-bugbot-effort-levels"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#what-are-bugbot-effort-levels" data-heading-base-id="what-are-bugbot-effort-levels" aria-label="Copy link to what-are-bugbot-effort-levels"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">What are Bugbot effort levels?</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Alongside usage-based billing, Bugbot supports configurable effort levels for reviews:</p>
<ul class="my-6 prose-ul-markers" style="list-style-type:square;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Low:</strong> Optimizes for cost, with quality close to Default. Reviews are cheaper and take longer.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Default:</strong> Bugbot continues to use the same effort level as it does today. Optimized for efficiency and speed.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>High:</strong> Bugbot spends more time reasoning. Reviews are more expensive and take longer, but Bugbot may find more bugs.</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><strong>Smart:</strong> Describe in natural language when Bugbot should use low, default, or high effort. Cursor will dynamically set effort levels based on your instructions.</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">You can configure effort levels from <strong>Settings</strong> in <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/automations/from-cursor/bugbot">Bugbot Automations</a>.</p>
<h2 class="text-medium mt-12 mb-4" id="how-to-switch-to-usage-based-bugbot-early"><a class="group flex items-center no-underline hover:no-underline" href="#how-to-switch-to-usage-based-bugbot-early" data-heading-base-id="how-to-switch-to-usage-based-bugbot-early" aria-label="Copy link to how-to-switch-to-usage-based-bugbot-early"><span data-heading-highlight-target="true">How to switch to usage-based Bugbot early</span><span class="ml-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-opacity group-hover:opacity-100"><div class="relative size-3" aria-hidden="true"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-copy absolute inset-0 size-3 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-100 scale-100" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="14" height="14" x="8" y="8" rx="2" ry="2"></rect><path d="M4 16c-1.1 0-2-.9-2-2V4c0-1.1.9-2 2-2h10c1.1 0 2 .9 2 2"></path></svg><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-check absolute inset-0 size-3 text-green-600 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out opacity-0 scale-50" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 6 9 17l-5-5"></path></svg></div></span></a></h2>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">Existing customers can switch to usage-based Bugbot in their <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="https://cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot?modal=migrate-bugbot">Cursor dashboard</a>.</p>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">If you switch early, Cursor will apply pro-rated credits for any pre-paid seat fees to your account.</p>
